invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of bulkInsert; exceptions are thrown before returning, so result must be non-null on successful exit.
Method signature guarantees result is of type HoodieWriteMetadata.
bulkInsert should return HoodieWriteMetadata with non-null WriteStatus list.
Method returns HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so getWriteStatuses() should be a List.
